body:
For me this command fails I think it is because of the `_` in the duration since it works when it is removed, have also added a little suggestion to make sure showing notifications is enabled and wrapped this in a tip to make it stand out a bit more.

```suggestion
::: tip

Showing desktop notifications requires starship to be built with `rust-notify` support. You check if your starship
supports notifications by running `STARSHIP_LOG=debug starship module cmd_duration -d 60000` when `show_notifications` is set to `true`.

:::
```
